description: Move the mouse on the remote computer of the open session. x and y are pixels of the remote picture (the size jrd_remote_screenshot reports as remote_width and remote_height) unless `relative` is true. Pass from_screenshot: true when they were read from a reduced remote screenshot. Requires an open session where this computer is the viewer.

from_screenshot.description: Set true when x and y were read from the last jrd_remote_screenshot picture. They are scaled to the remote screen for you.

relative.description: If true, treat (x, y) as a delta from the cursor's current position.

name: jrd_mouse_move
